front: Push a creature away with Athletics against its Fortitude DC.
back:
Athletics vs. Fortitude DC.
Crit Success: push target up to 10 ft away. You can Stride after it, moving the same distance in the same direction.
Success: push target 5 ft away; you may Stride after it the same way.
Crit Failure: you lose your balance, fall, and land prone.
